'''Pokémon Adventures: Best Enemies''' is the thirty-fourth monthly issue released by [[VIZ Media]] of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Mato]]. It contains chapters thirty-two, thirty-three, and thirty-four of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. The chapters originally released in this book were later rereleased as part of {{PAV|6}}. As a bonus, it contained a sheet of Pokémon stickers which were not included with the collected volume release.

==Important events==
* [[Koga]] and {{adv|Blue}} defeat [[Agatha]].
* [[Sabrina]] and {{adv|Green}} battle [[Lorelei]] after being frozen on the arms by her dolls of the duo.
* Sabrina defeats one of Lorelei's Pokémon.
* [[Lt. Surge]] and {{adv|Bill}} are challenged to a battle by [[Bruno]].
* {{adv|Yellow}} and [[Blaine]] catch up to Lt. Surge and Bill, but are blocked.
